title: How to put a team of AI experts on one job
seoTitle: How to put a team of AI experts on one job
description: Treat your AI like a team, not one assistant. Pick specialists with different methods, give each a seat, keep them apart and have an outsider check the work.
lede: One AI chat gives you one way of thinking. This guide shows how to put a small team of AI specialists on one job: a coordinator, makers with different methods, a critic and an independent checker, all in the AI you already use.
